reasons: QUICK TEST on 95 of 119 sampled DEV eval cases (gap 0.050, seed 0): exploratory, not a sealed verdict.
Quick test: the 'score close to its DEV score' check was not run (it needs the DEV report this test skips); the other checks ran.
Scope: 2 labels; a case not in scope counts right when the model answers any label outside the scope ('not_mine').
majority: 0.0% right on in-scope cases, 0.0% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
linear: 97.4% right on in-scope cases, 0.0% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
naive_bayes: 97.4% right on in-scope cases, 1.8% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
linear_svm: 100.0% right on in-scope cases, 1.8% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
random_forest: 89.5% right on in-scope cases, 3.5% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
boosting: 89.5% right on in-scope cases, 1.8% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
prompt: 76.3% right on in-scope cases, 0.0% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
agent: 94.7% right on in-scope cases, 1.8% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
cascade: 97.4% right on in-scope cases, 1.8% of other cases wrongly claimed as in scope
Early stopping: a gain of the gap is ruled out at 95 of 119 cases.
Repeated confidence interval for the gain: -0.068 to +0.029, valid at any look; an interval quoted below by the engine assumes a fixed-size run.
A gain of 0.05 or more is ruled out (CI -0.063 to +0.021), and linear costs no more per case under every price table.
Lower expected cost per scenario (price table@error cost): agent: none; linear: local_amortized@$0.5, local_amortized@$20, cloud_small@$0.5, cloud_small@$20, cloud_large@$0.5, cloud_large@$20.
No break-even error cost: the accuracy difference CI is not entirely above 0.
